items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] 'Cause there were quite a few of them down there. Honoré's came after you left, I think. [INTERVIEWEE] Uh, yeah, I guess so.

ctx.x: The Cotton Club – that was there. The Cotton Club was on "The Avenue" [Indiana Avenue], yeah. That was one. Let me see – [the] Sunset Terrace, [the] Cotton Club . . .
'Cause there were quite a few of them down there. Honoré's came after you left, I think.
